note: Also *well*: *Ich schlafe gut.* Most adjectives work as adverbs without any change.
Drops an *e* before an ending: *teurer, ein teures Auto*.
Drops the *c* before an ending: *ein hoher Berg*.
Also *evil*. In speech *sauer* is common for angry: *Bist du sauer?*
Drops an *e* before an ending: *dunkler, ein dunkles Zimmer*.
Takes no endings: *ein rosa Kleid*. The same for *lila* and *orange*.
